name: Campingplatz Aichalehof
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Aichalehof Camping Ground is located on the western shore of the Staffelsee and offers direct access to the water. Uffing is a small village in the Voralpenland region, about 20 kilometers east of Garmisch-Partenkirchen. The site features pitch sites, sanitary facilities, and a direct access path to the lake. Nearby, there are hiking trails, and the railway connection makes it easy to take day trips to the surrounding area. The area is rural, with meadows and forests.
